description: coil of wire r=1 on a helix of radius 10, pitch 5, 6 turns (base on z = 0)
formula: V = pi r_s^2 L, L = turns sqrt((2 pi R)^2 + pitch^2); z from r_s (1 - cos a) to pitch turns + r_s (1 + cos a), tan a = pitch / (2 pi R)

meshTolerance.reason: the wire is a 24-gon section along a 16-per-turn Catmull-Rom spline of the helix (measured 4e-4 on Manifold); the exact run tolerates 6e-3 for the spline path
